instruction.en-GB: Wash hands and courgette. An adult cuts it into even rounds on a stable board.
instruction.pt-BR: Lave as mãos e a abobrinha. Um adulto corta em rodelas iguais sobre uma tábua estável.

adultAssist.en-GB: Adults cut the courgette, handle raw egg safely and operate the air fryer and hot basket. Children mix the coating and help bread the slices with supervision.
adultAssist.pt-BR: Adultos cortam a abobrinha, manuseiam o ovo cru com higiene e operam a air fryer e a cesta quente. Crianças misturam a cobertura e ajudam a empanar com supervisão.

safety.en-GB: Wash hands after touching raw egg; keep raw egg separate from ready-to-eat foods. An adult handles the sharp knife, air fryer, hot basket and tongs. Keep children back from hot surfaces; cool bites before eating.

heatOrKnifeCue.en-GB: Adult handles sharp knife and any hot appliance.
heatOrKnifeCue.pt-BR: Um adulto cuida da faca afiada e de qualquer aparelho quente.

crossContaminationCue.en-GB: Use clean hands and equipment; check packaging for allergens.
crossContaminationCue.pt-BR: Use mãos e utensílios limpos; confira as embalagens para alergênicos.
